preconditions.description: The size of the binary tree N must be between 1 and 10,000.
The root of the binary tree must not be None.

postconditions.expression:
stdout == 'Modified Tree :
' + modified_tree_inorder + '
Doubly Link List :
' + dll_left_to_right + '
Doubly Link List :
' + dll_right_to_left
postconditions.description: The output must contain the inorder traversal of the modified tree, the DLL from left to right, and the DLL from right to left.

postconditions.expression: all(leaf in dll_left_to_right for leaf in leaf_nodes)
postconditions.description: All leaf nodes from the original tree must be present in the DLL from left to right.
The DLL from left to right must be the reverse of the DLL from right to left.
